edit.description: Add --no-save to the 'Consumer-install smoke' step's npm install line (~line 95) so the consumer stays unpinned, same fix already applied to the newer backlog-groomer smoke step.

summary: Consumer-install smoke npm installs without --no-save, so the pin trips engine handshake arm 2 (§10) and every step command refuses.

per.section: 10. Engine↔pin handshake via launcher-defers-to-pin (the gradlew pattern)

acceptance: Consumer-install smoke CI step's npm install records no @dtmd/flume pin in the consumer's package.json; the step's flume status/render commands run under handshake arm 3 (unpinned), matching the sibling backlog-groomer step's shape.
notes: Found auditing SECOND-REFERENCE-CHAIN's own CI step against this one. Reproduced locally (hermetic env): pin recorded + no provisioned install → engineHandshake refuses exit 2 on the step's own flume status/render calls. cli.test.ts's handshake suite confirms arm-2 is intended; this step just predates it.

edit.description: jobRun preflight (§5b steps 1-2) — likely culprit, runs before the loop lock check.
job-run→loop cmd rewrite and dispatch (~lines 840-1078) — the path between jobRun preflight and the loop.pid lock check at ~line 1059.

summary: job.integration.test.ts's lock-refusal case hangs indefinitely instead of exercising §5b step 3's unchanged loop lock.

tests.asserts: 'run refuses while another live loop holds the job's loop.pid' — job run exits 1, names the holder pid, leaves the holder's pidfile untouched (§5b step 3, no hang)

acceptance: VITEST_LANE=integration pnpm exec vitest run tests/job.integration.test.ts completes (no hang, was 120s+ with no output past the prior test); full pnpm test:integration green.
notes: Repro: VITEST_LANE=integration pnpm exec vitest run tests/job.integration.test.ts --reporter=verbose, second case in the §5b describe block. Not root-caused — the lock check itself (cli.ts ~1059-1078) is a fast synchronous existsSync+kill(pid,0), so the hang is plausibly upstream in jobRun's preflight (branch checkout / baton hibernating / chain load) before dispatch ever reaches it. Blocks JOB-INTEGRATION-LANE-CI-WIRING.

edit.description: Add a step running `pnpm test:integration` per §17's pre-merge/CI intent.

summary: The integration lane (`pnpm test:integration`) has no CI wiring; §17 names CI as its run site and it never runs anywhere.

per.section: 17. Test-suite lanes — integration tests off the in-worktree gate

acceptance: CI workflow runs `pnpm test:integration` as its own step, green.
notes: Blocked on JOB-RUN-LOCK-REFUSAL-HANG: examples.integration.test.ts and loop-process-boundary.integration.test.ts already pass clean locally, but job.integration.test.ts hangs — wiring CI before that's fixed just turns the hang into a stuck/timed-out runner.
